HTTP JSON only: no filesystem paths, commands, URLs, or writable caches. Identical rows are informational, not failure. Charge is the bounded compare, not a live quote, purchase, or ROI. Ordinary wallets sign through examples/customer-x402, not a precomputed signature. Initial live release accepts x402 only.
